whole.text: The document text I have doesn't say. Figure 1 appears on page 3 only as a caption ("The Transformer - model architecture"), and the extracted text carries no description of the boxes or their colours, so I can't tell you what colour they are. The only colour reference in the document is in the attention visualizations, where the caption of Figure 3 says different colours represent different heads p. 13. That is unrelated to the boxes in Figure 1. To see the colours you would need to look at the rendered figure on page 3 itself.
